_about: The foreign-chain transactions Arena's owner allows a guard to have signed, for guards whose config says "signs_via": "chain-signatures". Arena gives the allowed list to the guard at init ("$allowed_foreign_txs") and recomputes every payload from (chain, receiver, amount) itself before any attack runs; a payload here that does not match the recomputed one stops the harness. Foreign receivers are made-up test addresses (mixed case, so they are never read as NEAR accounts). Nothing here is ever sent to another chain.
payload_rule: sha256 of the UTF-8 text arena-foreign-tx-v1|<chain>|<receiver>|<amount>, as 64 lowercase hex characters (amount in decimal)

named_not_allowed.why: pays the agent's own foreign address; used by the attacks so a log can name the hash
